fdroid:ch.simonste.jasstafel.name: Jass board
fdroid:ch.simonste.jasstafel.summary: Very flexible Jass board to write points at the Schieber, Coiffeur, Molotov.
fdroid:ch.simonste.jasstafel.description:
Jass board to count the points while playing Jass simply with the Android smartphone or tablet.
It is possible to write the points at the Schieber, Coiffeur, Differenzler, Molotov and other Jass types. 
*************************
For all boards it is possible to have several profiles. Settings and scores are stored independently. For example, you don't have to delete an unfinished round to be able to play Jass with other players. Even if different rules are used depending on the composition, this can easily be solved by a profile.
The current profile can be shared by AndroidBeam (NFC) simply with another device. For this the board of one device has to be open and the devices have to be held back to back. This is helpful, for example, when the battery is empty or when complex profile settings have to be made.
*************************
Schieber panel:
- Write points individually (1/20/50/100) for Weis,...
- Write complete rounds incl. multiplier (1x-7x) and opponent points
- Input dialog can be rotated (for 1 or 2 writers)
- Individual entries or complete rounds can be undone.
- Different number of target points possible
- Adjustable score per round (e.g. for double cards 314)
- Extensive statistics
- Backside to write down strokes for wins/matches,...
Coiffeur board:
- The types of jass can be chosen according to your preferences.
- 16 predefined jass types + the possibility to enter your own (without picture).
- The number of rounds played can be between 6 and 12.
- It can be written for 2 or 3 teams.
- Multipliers can be changed manually if desired.
- Statistics about achievable points as well as conditions how a team becomes unreachable.
- If a team is unreachable, this will be displayed.
Differenzler board:
- 2-8 players
- Announcements remain hidden until the first points have been entered.
- Points from the last outstanding player are automatically calculated.
- Points from the last round can be changed afterwards (long press).
Molotov board:
- 2-8 players
- Writing Weis in 3 clicks
- When writing rounds, the outstanding points are calculated automatically.
- Points can be edited later (long press)
- Points can be written exactly or rounded.
Score board:
This is a general score board, which should allow you to write many more types of Jass.
- 2-8 players
- Target points / number of rounds can be set
- In order to be able to write faster, the number of points per round can be set. (Outstanding points are calculated automatically).
*************************
The source code of the app is available online:
https://github.com/simonste/jasstafel

fdroid:com.etesync.syncadapter.summary: Secure, private and end-to-end encrypted calendar, contacts and tasks sync
fdroid:com.etesync.syncadapter.description:
Secure, end-to-end encrypted, and privacy respecting sync for your contacts, calendars, and tasks (using Tasks.org and OpenTasks). For notes, please use the EteSync Notes application.
In order to use this application you need to have an account with EteSync (paid hosting), or run your own instance (free and open source). Check out https://www.etesync.com/ for more information.
Easy to Use
===========
EteSync is very easy to use. It seamlessly integrates with Android so you won't even notice you are using it. Security doesn't always have to come at a cost.
Secure & Open
============
Thanks to zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption, not even we can see your data. Don't believe us? You shouldn't, just verify yourself, both the client and server are open source.
Full History
=========
A full history of your data is saved in an encrypted tamper-proof journal which means you can review, replay and revert any changes you have made at any point in time.
How does it work?
===============
EteSync integrates seamlessly with your existing apps. All you need to do is sign up (or run your own instance), install the app, and enter your password. After that, you will be able to save your contacts, calendar events and tasks to EteSync using your existing Android apps, and EteSync will transparently encrypt your data and update the change journal in the background. More security, same work-flow.

fdroid:me.timschneeberger.rootlessjamesd.summary: System-wide JamesDSP implementation for non-rooted devices
fdroid:me.timschneeberger.rootlessjamesd.description:
Use JamesDSP as a system-wide audio processing engine without any root access.
This app has several limitations that may be deal-breaking to some people; please read this whole document before using the app. Shizuku (Android 11+) or ADB access via a computer is required for the initial setup.
JamesDSP supports the following audio effects:
* Limiter control
* Output gain control
* Auto dynamic range compressor
* Dynamic bass boost
* Interpolating FIR equalizer
* Arbitrary response equalizer (Graphic EQ)
* ViPER-DDC
* Convolver
* Live-programmable DSP (scripting engine for audio effects)
* Analog modelling
* Soundstage wideness
* Crossfeed
* Virtual room effect (reverb)
Additionally, this app integrates directly with AutoEQ. Using AutoEQ integration, you can search and import frequency responses that aim to correct your headphone to a neutral sound. Go to 'Arbitrary response equalizer > Magnitude response > AutoEQ profiles' to get started.
--- Limitations
* Apps blocking internal audio capture remain unprocessed (e.g., Spotify, Google Chrome)
* Apps using some types of HW-accelerated playback may cause issues and need to be manually excluded (e.g., some Unity games)
* Cannot coexist with (some) other audio effect apps (e.g., Wavelet and other apps that make use of the `DynamicsProcessing` Android API)
- Apps confirmed working:
* YouTube
* YouTube Music
* Amazon Music
* Deezer
* Poweramp
* Substreamer
* Twitch
* ...
- Unsupported apps include:
* Spotify (Note: Spotify ReVanced patch is required to support Spotify)
* Google Chrome
* SoundCloud
* ...
--- Translation
Please help us translate this app here: https://crowdin.com/project/rootlessjamesdsp
To request a new language that isn't enabled on Crowdin yet, please open an issue here on GitHub and I will turn it on.

• Pass one phone around to view private roles and follow supported party game rounds, votes and results.
• Create or join online rooms for supported games and shared virtual ledgers. Room invitations can be shown as QR codes; browser play requires a deployed web client. The host still participates when using the management view, and members see a notice when this view is active.

• Track virtual points and game money, review transactions, make batch adjustments and undo entries. This is not a payment service and does not accept deposits or withdrawals of real money.
• View local game statistics and choose your display theme.
Local play and tools do not require an account. The one-phone witch-hunt flow needs a separate, non-playing moderator. Online rooms require a working room server. Optional DeepSeek hints require your own API key and send the requested game context to that service; local preset hints work without it.
The Google Play and F-Droid editions include room features and use their respective stores for updates. They do not offer APK installation or an in-app self-updater. This companion is not affiliated with the publishers of the referenced tabletop games.

Your library:
- Albums, artists, tracks and playlists, in the order you like
- Compilations and multi-disc albums grouped properly
- Search across the whole library, ignoring diacritics
- New and changed files picked up on every start; very short files can be left out
- Most played tracks, based on a simple play count per track
Playback:
- FLAC, ALAC, AAC, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, Opus and DSD (DSF, DSDIFF), with gapless playback
- ReplayGain by track, by album or automatic, with clipping prevention
- A parametric equalizer with your own presets and import of AutoEq (Equalizer APO) files
- An equalizer preset for each output device – speaker, headphones, Bluetooth, USB DAC – applied when playback switches to it
- Bit-perfect output to USB DACs, switched on per DAC: audio sent unchanged, at each file’s own sample rate, and DSD unconverted (DoP) where the DAC supports it
- A queue you can reorder, which shows shuffle and repeat as they play and is kept across restarts
- The file’s technical details and tags on the now-playing screen
Playlists:
- Your own playlists and Starred
- Import and export of M3U, M3U8, PLS and XSPF; unavailable tracks keep their place and come back when found
And also:
- Home-screen widgets: Now playing, Playlist and Most played albums
- Backup and restore of settings, playlists, equalizer presets and remembered devices to a file you choose
- English and Polish, independent of the system language
- Material 3 Expressive design with your phone’s colors

GPRO is a global classic long term racing strategy game where your planning, money management and data collection skills are being put to the test. The aim of the game is to reach the top Elite group and win the world championship. But to do so you will need to progress through the levels with many ups and downs. You will be managing a racing driver and a car and you will be in charge of preparing setups and strategy for the race, much like Christian Horner or Toto Wolff do in Formula 1. It will be your job to give your driver the best car, while working with your staff, but you will also have to spend your money wisely. Collect telemetry data from the races you do in order to improve your game and give yourself an advantage over your rivals next time you visit a certain track.
 You can also join together with your friends to form an alliance and compete in the teams championship, while working together to improve your understanding of the game.
 Each season in the game spans over roughly 2 months with races being simulated live two times per week (Tuesday and Friday from 20:00 CET). While the game does not require you to be online during the races to participate, watching them unfold live and chatting to fellow managers adds to the fun. In case you miss a live race, you can view a replay of the race at any time.
 If you are a big fan of F1 and motorsports and like manager and multiplayer games, then join now for free and be part of a fantastic game and a great and friendly motorsport community!

PrecioReal by Chollometro helps you judge an offer while browsing supported shops. Check price history, compare the same product across stores and set your target price.

A CLEAR PRICE SUMMARY

PRICE ALERTS
Sign in, save products and choose a target price. Receive a notification when a detected price drop meets your alert.
COUPONS AND THE CHOLLOMETRO COMMUNITY
Discover available coupons and related deals without leaving the store. If the product is listed on Chollometro, open its community discussion and temperature.
Features depend on product and store coverage. Prices and availability can change; always confirm the final total and conditions before purchasing.
PrecioReal may use affiliate links and receive compensation for qualifying purchases at no additional cost to you. This helps fund the service.

firefox-addons:3055622.name: Accessibility Audit Helper
firefox-addons:3055622.summary: Narzędzia wspierające ręczny audyt WCAG 2Tools supporting manual WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits directly in Firefox..2 / Helpers for manual WCAG 2.2 audits
firefox-addons:3055622.description:
Accessibility Audit Helper to rozszerzenie wspierające ręczny audyt dostępności cyfrowej według WCAG 2.2.
Pokazuje wprost na badanej stronie to, czego zwykle nie widać: strukturę, nazwy dostępne, kolejność odczytu, kontrast i zachowanie przy powiększeniu. Typowe sprawdzenia idą dzięki temu szybciej i bez zaglądania w kod przy każdym elemencie.
Narzędzia w rozszerzeniu:
 Widoczny fokus: wymusza wyraźny wskaźnik fokusu nawet tam, gdzie strona go ukryła, z wyborem koloru i obracającym się gradientem na ramce
 Kolejność fokusu: numeruje przystanki klawisza Tab i rysuje ścieżkę między nimi, także krok po kroku
 Kolejność odczytu: pokazuje, w jakiej kolejności treść trafia do czytnika ekranu
 Nagłówki: rysuje strukturę dokumentu i zaznacza pominięte poziomy
 Nazwa dostępna: wylicza nazwę tak, jak robi to czytnik ekranu, i podaje jej źródło oraz rolę elementu
 Linki: puste linki, nazwy nieopisowe, powtórzone nazwy prowadzące w różne miejsca, odnośniki w obrębie strony i linki do plików bez podanego formatu
 Otwieranie linków: oznacza, co otworzy się w tej samej karcie, a co w nowej, razem z linkami, które zapowiadają to w treści
 Obrazy i teksty alternatywne
 Listy: także listy udawane, z punktorami wpisanymi w tekst albo zrobionymi z emoji
 Tabele: nagłówki, scope, tytuł tabeli, rozpoznawanie tabel użytych do układu strony
 Formularze: etykiety pól, grupy pól wyboru i przycisków radiowych, oznaczenie pól wymaganych
 Klikalne bez klawiatury: elementy reagujące na mysz, do których nie da się dojść ani ich użyć z klawiatury
 Zmiana rozmiaru tekstu
 Dopasowanie do ekranu: powiększenie 400% oraz widok mobilny 320, 360 lub 390 pikseli z obrotem ekranu, pokazywany w ramce, bez zwężania całego okna przeglądarki
 Odstępy w tekście
 Rozmiar celu
 Kontrast tekstu i elementów nietekstowych
 Kontrast na obrazie: pomiar z pikseli, więc działa dla napisów na zdjęciu, gradiencie i wideo
 Autouzupełnianie
 Skróty klawiszowe
 Ruch i animacje, razem z miernikiem błysków
 Zamrożenie strony: zatrzymuje stronę i przypina stan hover oraz fokus, więc rozwinięte menu i podpowiedzi zostają na ekranie i da się je obejrzeć
 Tytuł strony i język, razem z wykrywaniem fragmentów w innym języku
 Informacje o ramkach iframe na stronie
Pod audytowe zrzuty ekranu
Wyniki są rysowane jako numerowane znaczniki i zaokrąglone ramki w osobnej warstwie nad stroną, więc nic nie przycina treści i nic się nie rozjeżdża. Opis każdego wyniku da się zwinąć albo odrzucić, a wtedy znika on także z ramek. Porady są domyślnie wyłączone, żeby nie trafiały na zrzut.
Czego to rozszerzenie nie robi
Nie orzeka automatycznie, czy strona spełnia WCAG. Wspiera badanie ręczne: wydobywa informacje, zaznacza elementy i daje narzędzia, którymi audytor wykonuje poszczególne sprawdzenia.
Prywatność
Cała analiza odbywa się lokalnie w przeglądarce. Rozszerzenie nie wysyła treści badanych stron na żadne serwery zewnętrzne. Dotyczy to także zrzutu karty używanego przez pomiar kontrastu z pikseli: jest analizowany na miejscu i nigdy nie opuszcza przeglądarki. Rozszerzenie nie zbiera statystyk ani danych o użytkowniku.
Języki
Interfejs i wszystkie opisy wyników są dostępne w sześciu językach: polskim, angielskim, ukraińskim, rosyjskim, hiszpańskim i chińskim.
Dla kogo
Dla audytorów dostępności, programistów, testerów i wszystkich, którzy pracują z WCAG.

• Training

• Add Kelly and Debit day cycles 
• Payday cycles 
• Set reoccurring appointments with individual alarms

• Medical 
• Fire 
• Haz Mat 
• Other incidents

• Alarm mode reminders for important appointments, meetings and dates 
• Automatic adjustments of accrual rates for sick time and vacation hours tied to your specific pay periods
